purpose: Typed pilot separating mathematical definitions, theological commitments, operations and boundary conditions
scope: Awakening-response-restoration pilot. Not a complete axiom set and not a validation of theology.

operators.name: awaken
operators.actor: Divine actor in the intended interpretation; not inferred by Lean
operators.open_obligation: Independently justify phase meanings and divine attribution.

operators.name: respond
operators.input: consent Bool supplied externally to the function
operators.requires: awakened and consent=true to reach restored
operators.open_obligation: Input Bool does not prove free will, informed consent, absence of manipulation, or a universal soteriology.

operators.name: restore_standing
operators.actor: Interpretation of the composed route, not an added physical force
operators.open_obligation: Do not conflate standing with all psychological, moral or physical properties.

operators.name: sanctify
operators.reason: Ongoing development needs its own state and operation; idempotent standing reset does not imply growth is idempotent.

operators.name: forgive_or_pay
operators.open_obligation: Differentiate creditor, victim, judge, debtor and willing substitute. Paid debt + released offender does not select the judge.

boundary_conditions.condition: Response does not awaken a dormant state
False consent input blocks response restoration
boundary_conditions.not_proved: Causal non-coercion or resistibility across Christian traditions
Physical information conservation or inexhaustible historical ledger

boundary_conditions.condition: awaken and respond do not commute at a dormant starting state with consent true
A restored state is reachable by the defined sequence
Outside means outside a named family of admissible operations
Uniform positive integer cost per step implies cumulative demand exceeds any finite capacity
boundary_conditions.not_proved: An actually infinite reservoir exists or is God

acceptance_gate: Do not promote to canonical spiritual definitions until theological justification, rival interpretations, source version and empirical interpretation where applicable are reviewed.
